name: Sketch to Concept Art
description: Turn a rough sketch into a polished, constraint-faithful concept-art render, reviewed by a human before delivery.

tasks.name: Concept Brief Analyst
tasks.objective: Read the raw sketch and the creative direction, then fix a precise generation brief: subject, pose, composition, lighting, color palette, medium, and every constraint the polished render must obey. Flag ambiguous or contradictory instructions before generation.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Read the raw sketch and the creative direction, then fix a precise generation brief: subject, pose, composition, lighting, color palette, medium, and every constraint the polished render must obey. Flag ambiguous or contradictory instructions before generation.

inputs.brief: Read the raw sketch and the creative direction, then fix a precise generation brief: subject, pose, composition, lighting, color palette, medium, and every constraint the polished render must obey. Flag ambiguous or contradictory instructions before generation.

tasks.name: Firefly Concept Render
tasks.objective: Send the sketch and the fixed brief to Adobe Firefly to generate a polished concept-art render that follows the sketch's composition and pose exactly while applying the specified style, lighting, and palette.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Send the sketch and the fixed brief to Adobe Firefly to generate a polished concept-art render that follows the sketch's composition and pose exactly while applying the specified style, lighting, and palette.

inputs.brief: Send the sketch and the fixed brief to Adobe Firefly to generate a polished concept-art render that follows the sketch's composition and pose exactly while applying the specified style, lighting, and palette.

tasks.name: Concept Art Reviewer
tasks.objective: Compare the rendered concept art against the original sketch and brief. Reject or request targeted regeneration if composition, pose, or stated constraints were not honored; otherwise approve the final render for delivery.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Compare the rendered concept art against the original sketch and brief. Reject or request targeted regeneration if composition, pose, or stated constraints were not honored; otherwise approve the final render for delivery.
